negative_findings.description: Targeted search of SeeNews for Slovenian banking *technology* contracts returned only M&A, bond and financing items — no IT/vendor-selection stories surfaced.

negative_findings.why_it_matters: SeeNews should be tracked as an ownership/M&A early-warning source, not as a vendor-win feed; expecting contract news from it will produce false coverage confidence.

negative_findings.description: Slovenian-language search using procurement/selection phrasing ('banka ... izbrala ponudnika ... plačilni sistem ... pogodba') returned only regulator and collective-agreement pages, no news of a bank selecting a technology vendor.

brief: For Slovenian banking/payments vendor news, the English-language trade press is genuinely load-bearing rather than supplementary: FinTech Futures (which maintains a Slovenia keyword feed and carried the Oracle/SID Banka and Bankart/Nets stories), Finextra (both editorial and a vendor press-release channel) and The Paypers are the three sources that reliably surface deals, and they are frequently the only public record of them. SeeNews is the regional newswire of record but skews to M&A, ownership and financing rather than technology procurement — valuable as an early-warning signal that a bank is changing hands and will re-tender, not as a vendor-win feed. IBS Intelligence sits behind this as the only systematic vendor-deal register (Sales League Table, Core Banking Landscape reports), while STA English and Bankart's own newsroom form the sl-to-en bridge where announcements originate. A Slovenian-language search using procurement phrasing returned nothing, which corroborates the cell rationale but also flags that the sl anchors need reworking before concluding local coverage is absent.
